title: Prefill/Decode kernel fingerprinting + NVTX envelope for cross-span correlation
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: produce a low-overhead, deterministic fingerprint for kernels and a thin NVTX/trace envelope that ties kernel-level metrics to higher-level prefill/decode spans. This feature will enable root-cause attribution for performance regressions (e.g., 90th/95th token latency spikes) while keeping production overhead <1.5% p99 tail for common request shapes. We will emit: 1) stable kernel_fingerprint attribute (xxhash64 of kernel binary id + config tuple), 2) a lightweight NVTX envelope around prefill and decode phases with correlation tags (trace_id, span_id, fingerprint), and 3) a sampled set of per-kernel micro-metrics (exec_count, median_us, p95_us, memory_bytes) via OTel metrics exported to Prometheus/Grafana. The implementation minimizes allocations and uses the existing kernel launch hot path to compute & attach fingerprints. Decision: use xxhash64 for speed + canonical serialization of kernel descriptor. We will not embed kernel source code or byte blobs in traces; only fingerprint and human-readable kernel name when available.
comments: 2026-02-12 - Liam: Initial design sketch posted to Confluence and RFC created. Trade-offs: full binary digests vs descriptor fingerprinted; chose descriptor-based fingerprint to avoid size & security issues.
2026-02-18 - Review (Runtime team): Concern about fingerprint collisions. Action: add namespace prefix (arch+driver+model-version) and 64-bit xxhash to reduce collision risk while keeping size small.
2026-02-25 - Eng-Infra feedback: NVTX range metadata should be compact; avoid JSON blobs in NVTX. Use flat key=value tags and reserve 3 tag slots: kernel_fp, kernel_name_hint, launch_flags.

2026-03-03 - PR draft https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821 created. Contains kernel fingerprinting function, NVTX push/pop macros, and initial OTel metric definitions. Benchmark harness included.

2026-03-07 - Benchmark results: microbench harness (prefill-only) shows +0.6% median and +1.1% p99 overhead with full nvtx+metric emission at 1% sampling. Action: add adaptive sampling (1% continuous + 100% on request latency > threshold) to limit noise.

2026-03-10 - Design review: Observability agrees on metric names and labels. Agreed to export kernel_fp as label on histograms (limited cardinality via sampling) and as resource attribute on spans for indexing.

2026-03-14 - Implementation: NVTX envelope integrated; automated unit tests added for fingerprint stability across build variants. Preparing rollout plan and incremental migration for Dedicated clusters.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic kernel_fingerprint computed for identical kernel descriptors across builds and machines
NVTX push/pop envelope present for prefill and decode with tags: trace_id, span_id, kernel_fp, kernel_name_hint
Per-kernel histogram metrics emitted to OTel/Prometheus with documented metric names and labels
End-to-end dashboards (Grafana) showing kernel-level p50/p95/p99 and ability to filter by kernel_fp
Runtime overhead in production-like harness <1.5% p99 for common request shapes with default sampling
Rollout plan exists with canary traffic gating and on/off runtime flags for Dedicated & Private installs
